reviews.text: The "Rose" shade is beautiful and I'm interested in exploring more colors. The formula is hydrating and the lip liner blends very seamlessly. I've been enjoying the smudged lip look!
reviews.zh: 「Rose」色號好靚，我想試多啲色號。配方有保濕效果，唇線筆好易融合。我一直好享受暈染唇妝嘅效果！

reviews.text: I was so disappointed when I saw this and I saw the colour. It’s completely completely different to what you see on screen And I just won’t ever use it. I got hippie girl and it’s closer to a Fushia colour
reviews.zh: 我見到呢件嘢同個色嗰陣好失望。同屏幕上見到嘅色完全唔同，我絕對唔會再用。我買咗「hippie girl」，佢更接近 Fuchsia 色。

reviews.text: The shade is super pretty but I wouldn’t really recommend for darker skin tones like mine because the shade looks way lighter than it does in the photo but overall it’s really nice just not really shade inclusive
reviews.zh: 色號好靚，但我唔會特別推薦畀深膚色嘅人，好似我咁。色號上嘴比相入面淺好多。整體都好好，只係唔太照顧唔同膚色。

reviews.text: I bought the color Shading. It’s really good if you want a natural contour, the color is very light but I like it because it’s hard to overdo it. I just wish the pencil was a bit thinner
reviews.zh: 我買咗 Shading 色。如果你想要自然嘅修容效果，呢款好好，色好淺，但我鍾意佢，因為好難畫到太過。我只係希望支筆仔細少少。

reviews.text: This lip liner has a lovely color and is super easy to use. The texture is soft and smooth, making application effortless. It really enhances my lip shape and gives a polished finish, love it!
reviews.zh: 呢支唇線筆色好靚，好易用。質地軟滑，塗抹好輕鬆。好能突顯我嘅唇形，令妝容好精緻，好鍾意！

reviews.text: Easy to blend! Not much range if you have a deeper skin tone, even the brightest shade (one I got) looked quite light on me and I’m tan/medium:) good for over lining and that blurred lip look of kpop idols! And I would say the amount of product is not much considering the size of packaging but will probably last a while and definitely looks bright on camera than in real life as seen with the swatch in my hand🙂‍↕️ thank you!
reviews.zh: 好易融合！如果膚色比較深，色號選擇就唔多。即使係我買嗰隻最鮮艷嘅色，塗喺我身上都幾淡；我係小麥色／中等膚色 :) 好適合畫唇線，同韓星嗰種模糊唇妝！我覺得考慮到包裝嘅大細，產品份量唔算多，不過應該可以用耐少少；而且上鏡時一定比實物睇落更鮮亮，就好似我手上嘅色樣咁。多謝！🙂‍↕️

reviews.text: Amazing product! Great pigmentation, goes on so incredibly smooth and buttery. I love how it looks and feels on the lips, and the color is hard to come by in the western market. I’d recommend this to anyone who is interested in Korean makeup products. ♡
reviews.zh: 好正嘅產品！上色力好強，塗抹時非常滑順、好似牛油咁。我好鍾意佢喺唇上嘅效果同手感，而且呢個色喺西方市場好難買到。推薦畀所有有興趣用韓國化妝品嘅人。♡

reviews.text: Easy to line lips but not that easy to blend out as it dries very quickly and when you try to smudge it becomes patchy. It is a bit hard to use effectively. I chose this colour as description said it was good for cool skin tones but the colour is too bright and more milky than the hand swatch for it to be natural on me.
reviews.zh: 好易畫唇線，但唔係咁易融合，因為乾得好快，你想推開嘅時候就會斑駁。要用得好有少少難。我揀呢個色係因為介紹話適合冷調膚色，但個色太鮮，比手上色樣更加似奶白色，所以塗喺我身上唔自然。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
